calls.cmd:
cd app/prototypes && mkdir -p notifications/steps && cat > notifications/schema.ts <<'EOF'
export type NotificationKind

results.rule: Unread tab label carries the count
Notifications are a ul with an accessible name
Unread rows use ListItem variant muted
Unread is a visible word, not colour alone
Title is a real link (a href or Link)
No onClick on the ListItem row
Mark all as read is a ghost Button
Mark all as read is disabled when nothing is unread
Row action buttons name their notification
No destructive action on a notification row
No confirmation dialog (mark all is reversible)
Empty All says the user is all caught up
Error is Alert variant=danger with a Retry action
Marking read is announced in a live region
Time is a time element with dateTime
